item.upgrader.upgrader.desc: Right-click to open the upgrade station
menu.upgrader.title: ITEM UPGRADER
gui.upgrader.pick_input_hint: Drag it in from your inventory
config.upgrader.title: Upgrader Settings
config.upgrader.scope.local: Saved to this game's config file and applied at once
config.upgrader.scope.read_only: This platform cannot save the config from here
config.upgrader.scope.server_edit: Server settings: saved on the server and apply to every player
config.upgrader.scope.server_view: Server settings: only an operator can change them
config.upgrader.scope.no_answer: The server did not answer: it may run an Upgrader older than 1.3
config.upgrader.house_edge.tooltip: Multiplier on the raw value ratio. 1.0 = fair odds, 0.9 = 10%% house edge.
config.upgrader.max_chance.tooltip: Highest possible success chance, so a downgrade is never a free win.
config.upgrader.spin_ticks.tooltip: How long the wheel spins before the result lands. 20 ticks = 1 second.
config.upgrader.max_target_count.tooltip: Most target items one upgrade may ask for. The item's own stack size still applies.
config.upgrader.attempt_limit.tooltip: Attempts a player gets per window. 0 removes the limit.
config.upgrader.attempt_window.tooltip: Length of that window. 0 removes the limit.
config.upgrader.global_multiplier.toolti: Scales every item's price, fixed prices included. 1.0 leaves the numbers alone.
config.upgrader.item_prices.tooltip: Every item with its price: set a fixed price, a multiplier, or blacklist it.
config.upgrader.item_prices.title: Item Prices
config.upgrader.sort.name: Sort: Name
config.upgrader.column.price.tooltip: Fixed price for this item. Leave empty to use the computed price (shown in grey). Items crafted from it are repriced after saving.
config.upgrader.column.multiplier.toolti: Multiplier for this item, on top of the global one. Empty = 1.
config.upgrader.column.final.tooltip: The price the upgrader will use: (fixed or computed price) × global multiplier × item multiplier.
config.upgrader.column.blacklist.tooltip: Whether the item can be put in or chosen as a target.
config.upgrader.blacklist.on: Blacklisted: can't be upgraded or chosen. Click to allow.
config.upgrader.blacklist.builtin: Always blocked by the mod itself
config.upgrader.prices.live: Prices from the current world · %s of %s items
config.upgrader.prices.last_world: Prices from the last world played · %s of %s items
config.upgrader.prices.none: Join a world to see computed prices · %s of %s items
config.upgrader.prices.failed: Could not compute prices · %s of %s items
config.upgrader.prices.server: Prices from the server · %s of %s items
config.upgrader.server.saved: Upgrader settings saved on the server
config.upgrader.server.denied: You need operator rights to change the Upgrader settings
config.upgrader.server.too_big: Too many per-item changes to send to the server at once
